tagline.en_US: Zen Browser is a free and open-source fork of Mozilla Firefox with a focus on privacy, customizability and design.

description.en_US: Zen Browser is a free and open-source web browser based on Mozilla Firefox. It emphasizes user privacy, extensive interface customizability, and modern design. It provides a flexible and secure environment for everyday internet browsing.

tips: Copy and paste between your computer and the streamed desktop, including images, works over HTTPS: port 3001 or an HTTPS reverse proxy. Browsers block clipboard access over plain HTTP.
